Title: Community support for .NET 5 is ending on 8 May 2022

Body.Content:
On 8 May 2022, extended support for .NET 5 will end.  After that date, your applications that are hosted on App Service will continue to run and your existing workloads will not be impacted. However, we'll no longer provide patches or customer service for .NET 5.

Required action  
To minimize risk and potential security vulnerabilities, follow the steps to update your applications to .NET 6 before 8 May 2022.  

Help and support 
If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
